Subject: Runbook: Registrant embed UX staging + sponsor recording rights

Hi all,

Looping everyone together to finalize the staging runbook for next week’s joint webinar. Two asks I want to lock down today:

1) Registrant embed UX: Acme wants the embed widget on their site to pre-fill first/last/email and show a clear checkbox for "I consent to recording and clip reuse". We need to confirm whether Zoom and ON24 will surface the consent checkbox in the embed flow (not just on the hosted registration page).

2) Recording/clip rights: Heather (Acme) — they plan to repurpose up to 3 short clips and need explicit written confirmation of exportable recording access and retention window (30 days access for sponsor assets post-event).

Proposed runbook (high level):
- Tue 11/17 09:00 PT: Embed staging test (ON24 staging + Zoom fallback) — validate pre-fill, consent checkbox, and successful registrant mapping to Redwood QA.
- Tue 11/17 10:00 PT: Full stream dress rehearsal — collect local and cloud recordings, verify clip export permissions.
- Wed 11/18 08:00 PT: Post-test debrief, confirm retention/exports and update docs.

Attached: initial sponsor rights summary (acme_sponsor_asset_rights.pdf) and embed widget spec (embed_widget_spec.png). ON24 support — can you confirm where consent is stored (ON24 field vs. Zoom metadata) and whether the staging replay link will include the consent flag in the registrant CSV?

Marissa/Ben/Karthik — please flag any missing runbook steps or risks. I’ll publish a one-page checklist once we have confirmations.

Thanks,
Mina

Thanks Mina — quick confirmation from Acme side:

- We do require the explicit opt-in checkbox on the embed (not buried in terms). That checkbox text should read: "I agree to be recorded and allow Acme Corp to repurpose short clips for marketing use."
- 30 days post-event access to raw recording and an MP4 of any clips we ask to be exported is fine. If there are platform export limitations, we can accept a staged handoff to our media team via Drive.

Attached is a short doc with the legal-ready language and a list of assets we’ll request (acme_sponsor_asset_rights.pdf). We’d like to keep the registrant field set minimal: first name, last name, email, company (optional), consent checkbox.

Look forward to the staging test. Please include my PM, Jenna Park (j.park@acmecorp.com), in the rehearsal invite if possible.

Heather

Hi Mina and team,

Thanks for the details — ON24 support here. Quick answers and next steps:

- Consent storage: ON24 will persist a custom checkbox field on the registrant record (field ID: sponsor_consent) when using our embeddable registration widget. The same field is included in the registrant CSV export and in replay metadata. If the customer uses the Zoom registration fallback, Zoom will capture the checkbox as a custom question and we surface it in the same CSV export — we map it during the ingestion step.
- Pre-fill: Our embed supports URL querystring prefill for first_name, last_name, and email. Example: ?first_name=Heather&last_name=Lin&email=heather.lin@acmecorp.com. Please ensure the embed is hosted on a secure domain.
- Staging replay: I’ve provisioned a staging replay for the test and uploaded a tiny test clip — link: https://on24.staging/replay/abc123 (also attached as on24_staging_replay_link.txt). The replay metadata includes sponsor_consent for the test registrant.

Action items for the runbook:
1) Embed staging: engineering to validate pre-fill and that sponsor_consent is present in export.
2) Registration CSV mapping: Marissa to verify Redwood ingestion picks up sponsor_consent as boolean.
3) Recording export path: Ben to confirm that post-event we can generate an MP4 clip via ON24 and provide via Drive link to Acme (30-day access).

We’re available for a 45-minute run-through on 11/17 at 09:00 PT. Reply here if you'd like a calendar invite.

Best,
Luis Campos
Technical Account Manager — ON24 Support
support@on24.com
